title: Parade bands then and now
summary: Old parade bands had more big brass instruments than today's.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Is there anything you can tell us about the parades when you were a boy? What the band sounded like? Have you heard any of the parades recently within the last few years?

Yeah, I heard they have a parade around here. They have two parades every year, the Jolly Boys. And all the bands at the time when they were, my dad and them's time, I think they had a larger band. They had more big brass instruments in the band than they have now. I remember that they used to have those big brass horns and all that, very big things.

Yeah, in them time. But now they don't have all that. I don't see that in the bands no more. Those parades we've been having, I haven't been seeing that recently. Yeah. Not in these late years. Those fathers that played all those kind of years, we looked like they ain't got nobody want to carry nothing like that anymore.
